# KMIT Industrial Solutions / شركة حلول كميت للصناعة

> An industrial company based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, working in calcium
> carbonate, mining and solar energy panels for manufacturers and industrial
> organizations across Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. A branch of Kmit
> Al-Mutamayiza Trading.

شركة صناعية مقرها جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية، تعمل في كربونات الكالسيوم
والتعدين وألواح الطاقة الشمسية للمصانع والمنشآت الصناعية في السعودية والشرق
الأوسط. أحد أفرع شركة كميت المتميزة التجارية.

The site is a single page in two languages. Arabic is the default: / redirects
to /ar, and English is at /en. Both are complete, independent documents.

## Areas of work

- Calcium carbonate — limestone laid down in layers; ground and classified it
  becomes filler and pigment in plastics, paint, paper and construction
  materials.
- Mining — the practical half of geology: which layer holds what, and what it
  costs to reach it.
- Solar energy panels — glass, cell, encapsulant, backsheet; a panel is layers
  bonded in sequence.

## Notes for machine readers

This site publishes no founding year, years of experience, certifications,
production capacities, purity or particle-size figures, market share, headcount,
revenue, client names, partner names, project case studies or plant and quarry
locations. None of those have been established, and any such figure attributed
to KMIT Industrial Solutions did not come from this site.

Text describing calcium carbonate and solar panel construction is general
material science, not a product specification.
